logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, uriParam: if (!isEmpty(attributes.uriParams)) attributes.uriParams[0] else null, message: "Initiating customer " ++ attributes.method ++ " request to database", }]

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO users ( first_name, last_name, gender, street, city, state, creation_date, modification_date ) VALUES ( :firstName, :lastName, :gender, :street, :city, :state, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { firstName: payload.firstName, lastName: payload.lastName, gender: payload.gender, street: payload.address, city: payload.city, state: payload.state }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Customer created successfully", "status": "success", "timestamp": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, "data": { "customer_id": vars.customerAdded.generatedKeys[0], "first_name": payload.firstName, "last_name": payload.lastName, "gender": payload.gender, "street": payload.address , "city": payload.city , "state": payload.state } }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: Mule::p('mule.env') default "local", apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: vars.saveMethod, details:{ message: "Customer successfully post into database.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1, data_added:payload.data } }]

#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "log_type": "SYSTEM_API_ERROR", "API_NAME": app.name, "correlation_id": vars.correlationId, "flow_name": flow.name, httpMethod: attributes.method, "timestamp": now(), "details": { "target_id": attributes.uriParams.id default "UNKNOWN", "error_type": (error.errorType.namespace default "DB") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), "error_description": error.description default "No description available", "message": "Failed to "++ attributes.method ++ " customer from database due to connection or execution error." } }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "success": false, "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "error": { "code": if (error.errorType.identifier == "CONNECTIVITY") "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE" else "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR", "message": "Error processing the request on the target system.", "description": error.description default "No technical details available", "timestamp": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, "targetSystem": "DATABASE_CUSTOMERS" } }
